item.title: Governing safety in connected and automated vehicles: evidence, ethics, and policy innovations
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on governance frameworks and policy approaches for ensuring safety in connected and automated vehicles. The issue seeks to integrate empirical evidence, ethical considerations, and innovative policy solutions to address the complex challenges posed by autonomous vehicle deployment in real-world transportation systems.

Appel publié par Transportation Research Part A: Policy and Practice. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Timeline

  • January 30, 2027: Submission deadline

item.title: How new technologies reshape public transport satisfaction
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines how emerging technologies are transforming public transport systems and affecting passenger satisfaction. It seeks research investigating the relationship between technological innovations and users' experiences with transit services, including digital solutions, smart mobility systems, and other technological advancements reshaping the transportation landscape.

Appel publié par Transportation Research Part A: Policy and Practice. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Impact of emerging technologies on public transport user satisfaction
  • Digital innovations in transportation systems
  • Technology adoption in transit services
  • User experience and satisfaction in modern public transport
  • Smart mobility solutions and passenger perception

Timeline

  • June 10, 2027: Submission deadline
